mapper.sql: s.id, s.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.image AS productImage, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.spec_json AS specJson, s.stock, s.min_stock AS minStock, s.max_stock AS maxStock, s.status, s.price
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id
AND (s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
AND s.min_stock > 0 AND s.stock < s.min_stock AND s.status = 1
ORDER BY s.stock ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id
AND (s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%'))
AND s.min_stock > 0 AND s.stock < s.min_stock AND s.status = 1
SELECT FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.min_stock > 0 AND s.stock < s.min_stock AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.stock ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product_sku s WHERE s.min_stock > 0 AND s.stock < s.min_stock AND s.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product_sku WHERE status = 1
SELECT p.name AS productName, s.spec_text AS specText, s.stock FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.stock DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS skuId, p.name AS productName, s.spec_text AS specText, s.stock, s.min_stock AS minStock, CASE WHEN s.stock = 0 THEN 'urgent' WHEN s.stock < s.min_stock * 0.3 THEN 'high' ELSE 'mid' END AS riskLevel, ROUND(s.stock / NULLIF(s.min_stock, 0), 2) AS stockRate, COALESCE(t.todayOut, 0) AS todayOutQty FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(qty) AS todayOut FROM stock_transaction WHERE type = 'OUT' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() GROUP BY sku_id ) t ON t.sku_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.min_stock IS NOT NULL AND s.stock < s.min_stock ORDER BY s.stock ASC LIMIT #{limit}
